title: neottia asiatica
intro: Neottia asiatica, commonly known as the Asiatic orchid or Chinese orchid, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Orchidaceae. It is traditionally used in Asian medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in the management of diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Neottia asiatica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids, phenolic compounds, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties.
